text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPM-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"INDUCTION HARDENED TO BE DONE FOR INDICATED AREA"}],"comment":"Note N1 refers to an indicated area for induction hardening, but no hatched or marked region (XXXXX) is shown on the drawing. Without a defined zone the heat treater cannot know where to apply induction hardening; the designer must add a cross-hatched or outlined area on the view.","recommended_correction":"Add a clearly marked (hatched or outlined) area on the drawing showing exactly where induction hardening applies."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"--"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) PROFILE CUTTING SHOULD BE DONE. 2) TO BE CASE CARBURISING DONE. 2) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 50 ~ 55 HRC. 3) CASE DEPTH 0.8~ 1.2 mm."}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field reads '--' while note N3 specifies case carburising and induction hardening, with no manufacturing stage defined for either treatment. This ambiguity can cause the shop to apply treatments in the wrong sequence relative to machining, risking scrap or out-of-tolerance features; the designer must fill the heat treatment field and state in N3 when each treatment occurs (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding).","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field and revise note N3 to specify the manufacturing stage at which case carburising and induction hardening are to be performed."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7 (+0.012/0)"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 14 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Holes D4 (Ø6 H7) and D5 (Ø14 H7) carry tight ISO fits on a part that receives I.Z.B.P. plating per the title block, yet neither dimension accounts for plating buildup. Plating will reduce the bore diameters and can prevent mating pins from assembling; the designer must adjust the pre-plate hole sizes or tolerances to allow for the specified coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Revise dimensions D4 and D5 to include allowance for the I.Z.B.P. plating thickness so the finished bores remain within H7 limits after coating."}]}
